rounds.question: Requirements check for JOBPERM-3: the durable card path retries deliveries. For a retired card that was deleted, a later retry (e.g. after a restart) must not try to delete again or re-send a receipt. Should the deleted state be recorded on the revision (idempotent, recommended) or should retries simply tolerate a 'message not found' error?
options: Record 'deleted' on the revision; retries no-op (Recommended)
rounds.chosen: Record 'deleted' on the revision; retries no-op (Recommended)
